messages:
deploybot: NOTICE: prod serving pool 3 failed healthcheck at 2026-06-14T21:13:20Z. Auto-rollback suppressed (release pin: compliance-hold). Proposed hotfix: redwood/inference:2026-06-14-hf-kvfix. Requesting expedited unpin and a 25m change window to roll the hotfix. Need release-lead + compliance ack. @ravi @tara please ack.

ravi: dropping in. what's the short failure log?

deploybot: failing probe: /generate p95=1300ms (baseline 200ms). snippet:
```
ERROR runtime.kv-cache: eviction storm -> cache-miss spike -> served fallbacks
caller: runtime/serve:handle_request
metrics: kv_evictions/sec=450 -> 1200 at 21:12:14 UTC
```

mel: this smells like the recent dynamic-quant rollout that tweaked kv-ttl. hotfix reverts that tweak + raises soft-eviction threshold. verified in staging with latency harness (5 runs).

ops-oncall: infra status: nodes healthy, short CPU bursts at deploy time, no IO issues. no other rolling tasks. recommend freeze of new deployments during the window.

compliance-bot: HOLD: this release is pinned by compliance policy CP-7 due to a downstream contract. Manual signoff required from compliance to lift pin. @tara please confirm.

tara: i'm on it. legal/compliance asked for a short customer note and audit trail before unpin. i'll draft and approve if telemetry looks good.

ravi: roll plan proposal: 1) lift pin (manual approval) 2) canary 5% for 8m 3) checkpoint and manual handoff to oncall 4) ramp to 50% for 10m 5) final ramp to 100% if stable. rollback triggers: p95 > baseline*1.3 OR errors > 0.5% OR kv_evictions/sec > baseline*2.

mel: QA quick-check: smoke+latency-harness green, no model output diffs, 6/6 smoke runs.

ops-oncall: require deploybot flags: `--freeze-new-deploys --manual-handoff` and an audit tag. also request a short rollout note in release metadata.

ravi: deploybot queue with override once tara signs. include `--manual-approval` so release-lead must confirm telemetry before ramp to 50%.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy release --image redwood/inference:2026-06-14-hf-kvfix --scope canary --ramp 5% --observe 480s --auto-rollback "p95>+30% || errors>0.5% || kv_evictions>2x" --override-pin release-lead-ravi --freeze-new-deploys --manual-approval --audit "unpin-compliance-0614"`

compliance-bot: tara acknowledged and will publish customer note on approval. waiting for tara signoff.

tara: I reviewed the draft customer note and legal is ok. i'll +compliance-approve once initial canary metrics are green.

ravi: +approve (release lead, expedite) contingent on compliance ack at canary checkpoint.

mel: +eng.

deploybot: APPROVAL (release-lead): ravi. Lifting pin is pending compliance final signoff (tara). Starting canary will wait until compliance toggles `--compliance-ok` flag.

compliance-bot: tara toggled compliance flag: `--compliance-ok` at 21:18 UTC.

deploybot: 21:19 UTC - canary 5% started. telemetry will post every 2m.

mel: watching request traces and error stream. initial p95=230ms (baseline 200ms). kv_evictions/sec down to 220.

deploybot: 21:27 UTC - telemetry update: p50/p95/p99 = 35ms/240ms/680ms (baseline 30/200/600). errors 0.06%. kv_evictions/sec stabilized. holding for manual checkpoint per `--manual-approval`.

ops-oncall: recommend handoff now to oncall for final go/no-go. ravi please confirm.

ravi: handing off to oncall: @ops-oncall you have 6m to validate and either `+handoff-approve` to continue ramp or `+rollback` to stop.

ops-oncall: reviewing metrics and logs now. p95 within threshold, errors low, evictions trending down. +handoff-approve.

deploybot: manual approval received from ops-oncall. commencing ramp to 50% over 7m.

deploybot: 21:36 UTC - ramp to 50% complete. telemetry: p95=210ms, errors 0.04%.

tara: customer note published and changelog updated: https://go/release/2026-06-14-hf-kvfix. Dedicated customers notified.

ravi: final ramp to 100% after 10m stable window. ops please keep an eye.

ops-oncall: monitoring. will trigger immediate rollback if kv_evictions/sec climbs or p95 crosses threshold.

deploybot: 21:48 UTC - final ramp to 100% complete. pin removed, audit record saved: unpin-compliance-0614, run-id 20260614-c3d.

mel: confirming production smoke is green, no regressions observed.

ravi: thanks all. follow-up actions: postmortem to capture why quant rollout impacted kv-ttl and add a gating test to our rollout checklist. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
